subject: AWS Marketplace listing readiness: localization, pricing claims, and onboarding gaps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-16T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: AWS listing — initial feedback from Acme + AWS partner review

Hi team,

Quick summary from this morning's sync with Acme (Alice) and a short thread from AWS Partner enablement: they returned the draft listing with three categories of asks: localization language for EU/UK, clearer pricing claim language for marketplace copy, and onboarding flow details for PrivateOffer/trial SKUs. I pulled the highlights into the attached doc (listing_draft_v3.docx) and the SKU table.

Top asks:
- Localize hero subtitle for UK/EU (they want British English spelling/metric examples).
- Remove the phrase "instant ROI" and replace with measurable claim tied to our benchmark ("typical customers see 20-30% lower inference cost per 1M tokens") — legal wants a source reference.
- Add a short step-by-step trial onboarding paragraph for PrivateOffer (how customers get keys, trial length, entitlements).

Can you do a quick pass on copy + pricing footnotes and confirm whether we can include the benchmark stat by EOD Monday? Aditya: can you check the SKU trial entitlements and confirm the 14-day default we showed in demo is allowed for Private Offers? Kimberly: please review the hero/subtitle localization and suggest US/UK variants.

Attachments: listing_draft_v3.docx (proposed copy w/ comments), sku-pricing-table.csv, screenshot_product-page.png

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Partner GTM Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing — initial feedback from Acme + AWS partner review

Marissa — thanks, looping back with an annotated pass. Notes inline on the doc and a few highlights below:

1) Hero/localization
- US hero: "Production-grade LLM inference: predictable latency, lower unit cost"
- UK/EU hero variant suggestion: "Production-grade LLM inference — predictable latency and reduced per-token cost" (uses British punctuation and "reduced" phrasing).
- Suggested copy for metric examples: use "requests per minute" and "latency (ms)" rather than imperial/metric to avoid confusion.

2) Pricing claims and benchmark
- I removed "instant ROI" from the hero and replaced it with: "Customers commonly reduce inference cost by 20–30% at scale (see notes)".
- We need a short footnote that points to our internal benchmark (Benchmark report Q1 2026). Legal will require a link/reference; I put a placeholder in the doc.

3) Onboarding / trial flow
- Proposed 3-line onboarding snippet for the product page that we can include under "Getting started":
  • Request PrivateOffer trial via AWS — enable trial SKU
  • Provision VPC connector and KMS key (if required)
  • Start test workload — trial lasts 14 days by default
- If Aditya confirms 14 days is the canonical entitlement we can keep it; otherwise I'll change to "up to 14 days".

I've attached a screenshot with recommended CTA copy. Small editorial asks in the doc for tone consistency. Happy to hop on a quick 20-min sync.

Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
GTM Content Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T13:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing — initial feedback from Acme + AWS partner review

Quick verification from infra/ops side: 14-day trial via PrivateOffer is supported as a default entitlement for this SKU family. A couple of constraints to surface:
- PrivateOffer trials cannot be auto-provisioned in some GovCloud/AP regions; for now Acme is US so we're fine.
- If we advertise the 20–30% cost reduction as a typical range we must include the workload profile used for the benchmark (100k tokens/day, latency SLA 100ms) — otherwise legal flags it.

I double-checked the sku-pricing-table.csv and updated the entitlement column for trial length. Attachment updated and uploaded to the Drive link.

Short next steps from me: confirm trial entitlement in the listing copy and add a brief "trial limitations" footnote pointing to the benchmark appendix.

-Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Product Ops, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Partner Program <aws-partners@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing — initial feedback from Acme + AWS partner review

Thanks Marissa/Kimberly/Aditya — this is helpful. Two clarifying Qs from our side before we approve the copy:

1) The trial flow mentions KMS keys and VPC connector. For our procurement team, can you confirm whether Redwood will support a short integration runbook (1 pager) to hand to our infra team? We have a strict security checklist.

2) On the cost reduction claim: can you provide the exact benchmark appendix or a public-friendly summary we can paste into our procurement notes? We can't include internal-only links.

If you can share a 1-page runbook + a public-friendly footnote by Wednesday (8/19) that'd be great. We are aiming to go live on the listing by the end of August.

Best,
Alice

--
Alice Nguyen
Head of Cloud Integrations, Acme Analytics
alice@acme-analytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@acme-analytics.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing — initial feedback from Acme + AWS partner review

Alice — appreciated. Quick status update and commitments:

- Runbook: Aditya will produce a 1-page integration runbook (privileged network steps + KMS checklist) and I will convert it to a public-friendly one-page (redact internal ops notes) by EOD 8/19.
- Benchmark summary: Kimberly will draft a public-friendly footnote that includes the workload profile and % range but points to a public appendix hosted on our docs site (no internal Drive link). Target EOD 8/19.
- Legal/claims: I'll loop in Legal first thing Monday to make sure the phrasing meets the marketplace claim requirements and to finalize the citation.
- AWS co-sell badge: AWS asked that we confirm case studies / customer references prior to co-sell approval. Alice, would Acme consider being a reference? Short Q&A and permission to use a one-paragraph quote would help accelerate the badge.

Action items assigned:
- Aditya: 1-page runbook (public safe) — 8/19 EOD
- Kimberly: public benchmark footnote + hero variants — 8/19 EOD
- Marissa: legal sign-off loop + follow up with AWS partner team on co-sell requirements — 8/23
- Alice: confirm whether Acme can be a reference (yes/no) by 8/19

Thanks — I think this puts us on track for an end-of-August listing date if all deliverables land. I'll update HubSpot (HS-12477) after we have the runbook and footnote.

Cheers,
Marissa
